text:
Sam: Heads-up — Horizon Freight just asked about a new mobile OCR + on-device summary workflow. They want to onboard 4 teams (field intake, reconciliation, returns, analytics), targeting ~350-420 reqs/min at peak. Asking for Private deployment (VPC + on-prem edge cache) and mobile SDK support. Go-live target: ~8 weeks before renewal. Could be a meaningful ARR expansion if we size it right, or a churn risk if we can't meet controls.
Priya: Do we have any sample prompts from them? need token estimates before sizing.
Sam: They attached a sample batch (snippet below). Rough averages: prompt ~60 tokens, response ~180 tokens. If we assume 400 reqs/min -> (60+180)*400 = ~96k tokens/min -> ~138M tokens/day. They also mentioned plans for EU + US regions.
Sam: ```
PROMPT: "Scan invoice image, extract invoice number, vendor, total, and a 2-sentence summary for driver notes."
RESPONSE: "Inv# 78234; Vendor: NorthHaul; Total: $4,212.45. Summary: 'Driver reported damaged pallet on arrival; partial delivery accepted pending claims.'"
```
Alex: That daily token volume is well above hosted tiers. Recommend Dedicated baseline (3 reserved nodes) with autoscale to 6 for peak bursts, or Private with a regional edge cache per continent. We'll need to quantify latency SLOs for mobile (aim <250ms p50). Also consider quantized model variants for edge.
Jules: From enablement: SSO/SCIM, retention and data routing policy, mobile SDK sample app, CORS/networking checklist, and a short PII handling questionnaire for their legal/compliance team. I can assemble a runbook + 90min workshop and a lightweight pilot plan.
infra-bot: quota-check: hosted_quota=3M tokens/day, reserved_capacity=0, recent_peak=2.1M tokens/day
Priya: Oof. We need to propose Dedicated or Private options and a quick sizing workshop with their infra. Can we get a traffic profile (spike windows) from them before the sync?
Alex: I'll prepare a perf vs cost table for Dedicated(3) vs Dedicated(4-6 burst) vs Private. Free to do a tech sync Tue 2-3 PT.
Sam: I'll loop in AE and CS lead. If we can present a clear Dedicated plan + pilot and a path to Private later, renewal risk drops. If we only offer hosted with throttles, they might walk.
Priya: Action items: 1) Sam -> schedule tech sync + include AE, 2) Alex -> sizing + perf table, 3) Jules -> runbook + workshop agenda + PII survey, 4) Infra -> confirm EMEA feasibility and edge-cache ops.
Jules: I'll also draft a short customer-facing one-pager comparing Dedicated vs Private for them.
Alex: Will post initial numbers here after the whiteboard.
Sam: Thanks all — prioritizing this for the week. :rocket:
